title: Sundial deploy compact checklist and ops calendar
content:
Sundial launch compact notes (working draft)

Purpose:
- Short, operator-friendly checklist + 7-day calendar for the Sundial model routing/parameter-shift release. Keep light but concrete so on-call can run it with minimal context.

Scope:
- Host: hosted-api + dedicated pools.
- Surface changes: routing policy change to prefer v2 quantized model for low-latency tier; new autoscale tuning; cache prefixing enabled for warm sessions.

Goals for this rollout:
1) Maintain 95th pct latency under 180ms for short chat flows.
2) No more than 1.5x baseline cost-per-token after batching adjustments.
3) Zero customer-facing errors for first 24h.

7-day calendar (compact):
- Day -3 (2024-04-05): Cut release branch, smoke tests in staging. Load tests 30m at 2x expected QPS. Owner: Daniel K.
- Day -2 (2024-04-06): Dry-run deploy to canary1 (us-west1). Night window 00:00-02:00. Observability checklist run.
- Day -1 (2024-04-07): Canary feedback review; adjust autoscale threshold + batch window. Readout at 11:00 PT.
- Day 0 (2024-04-08): Staggered ramp: 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% over 6 hours with pause gates. Ops lead: Aisha P.
- Day +1 (2024-04-09): Monitoring spike review; run short synthetic prompt sweep for quality.
- Day +3 (2024-04-11): Cost curves and effective batch sizes - optimization pass.
- Day +7 (2024-04-15): Postmortem lite and release notes finalization.

Preflight checklist (must pass before Day 0):
- [ ] Release branch built and pinned (GH: platform/pull/7421).
- [ ] Canary config uploaded and verified in infra (terraform plan applied).
- [ ] Health checks in mesh are green for 30m with smoke payload.
- [ ] KV cache warmup script executed and hit-rate > 65% in canary.
- [ ] Autoscaling policy file validated (min/target/max) and dry-run ok.
- [ ] Observability dashboards linked: latency-ops, error-rate-alerts, cost-per-token.
- [ ] Incident channels prepped: #release-sundial, #sre-oncall, PagerDuty rotas confirmed.

Rollout steps (operator play):
1) Create canary traffic slice (5%) routed to v2 quantized. Wait 15m.
2) Run quick synthetic regression (10 prompts across categories). If quality drop > 3% fail gate.
3) Increase to 20% if latency and errors within thresholds for 30m.
4) At each step, run autoscale sanity: verify pod counts stabilise with target CPU/GPU util.
5) If any fatal alert fires (see alert list below), immediately rollback to v1 routing and scale back to baseline.

Key telemetry & thresholds:
- p50/p95 generation latency: target p95 < 180ms (short flows).
- error rate: increase must be < 0.02% absolute vs baseline.
- tail OOMs: zero tolerated; any OOMs -> immediate rollback.
- cost-per-token: monitor; alert if > 1.8x baseline for 1h.
- cache hit-rate: target >= 60% within first 2h.

Watchlist alerts (predefined):
- ERR_RATE_HIGH (alerts if error rate delta > 0.02).
- LATENCY_P95_SPIKE (p95 > 180ms for 10min).
- AUTOSCALE_FLAP (more than 3 scale events within 5m).
- OOM_DETECTED (any container OOM).

Rollback criteria (explicit):
- Quality regression > 3% on synthetic evals or user-reported degradations in first 2h.
- Any OOM_DETECTED or latency p95 > 220ms sustained for 30m.
- Cost-per-token > 2.0x baseline for 1h.
Rollback action: route traffic back to v1 routing, scale down v2 pool, create incident with severity: sev2 and owner assigned.

Throttle tuning notes (ops heuristics):
- Start with batch window 8ms for short sequences; bump to 12ms if throughput low and latency still within p95 target.
- Set burst capacity throttle at 150% of expected baseline QPS. If autoscale lags, open safety lane to reject non-critical heavy requests for 10m.

Draft release notes (to be polished for product):
- Feature: Sundial routing enables a quantized v2 for low-latency tier, reducing median latencies and improving cost efficiency for short chat workloads.
- Ops: New autoscale policy defaults and cache prefixing introduced. Rolling deploy performed Apr 8, 2024.
- Known limitations: Slightly higher variance for long-context generations; tuning scheduled Day +3.

Open questions / TODOs:
- QA: need expanded test prompts for technical-support vertical (assign to Marta).
- Legal: confirm data-handling note for caching behavior (in-flight with privacy).
- Instrumentation: add a synthetic metric for token-level latency by model-version.

Contacts & short roster:
- Release lead: Aisha Patel (aisha@redwood.ai)
- SRE oncall shift: Daniel Kim (pager)
- Observability/telemetry: Lucas Ortega
- QA owner: Marta Silva

Notes to self: keep the Day 0 ramp conservative. If you see odd tail latency noise, pause and run the synthetic sweep — it catches the weird cases.

End of draft. Will convert to formal release notes after Day +1 review.
